name: paypal-sdk
description: Install and consume the PayPal Server SDK for .NET, grounded in a bundled SDK map. A single paypal-sdk agent plans a map-grounded contract sheet, answers narrow contract questions, and fixes SDK compile/build errors in place — cloning the SDK source only when the map cannot settle a fact. Includes the integrate-paypal router and the map-grounded paypal-sdk agent. No MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: PayPal Server SDK (.NET) integration, grounded in a bundled SDK map.
